children: His Majesty Sultan Haitham bin Tarik visited the Special Economic Zone at Duqm (SEZAD) on Wednesday.

During the visit, His Majesty reviewed the most significant economic, investment and development projects in the zone, the expansion it has witnessed in recent years, and efforts to transform it into an integrated economic zone.
His Majesty the Sultan heard a briefing on the zone and the Port of Duqm, the achievements and future plans to create a conducive investment environment and attract more local and foreign investment.

His Majesty the Sultan gave directives to continue investing in the zone’s assets to consolidate its position as a promising economic and logistics hub and maximise the benefits of its strategic location.

title: ZAWYA: His Majesty Sultan Haitham reviews economic, investment projects at SEZ in Duqm
